body: {"better": "B", "reason": "Card A says 'ఎవరికీ డబ్బులు ఇవ్వకండి' (don't give money to anyone), which is an invented restriction not in the outing details and contradicts shopping at a Lebensmittelhändler where payment is expected. Card B correctly limits the warning to bank details and strangers. However, Card B also has 'మంచి కూరగాయలు' (good vegetables) which slightly exceeds 'Lebensmittelhändler' but is closer than A's error. Both have minor issues, but A's 'don't give money to anyone' is a more significant unsupported invention that would confuse a shopping trip."}
